author: ojiudezue
title: Live-room establishment restores the operator's round-4 rule the orchestrator overrode in round 5; failed room = not defined in URA
summary: v5.103.15 (in review) computes zone establishment over rooms actually running: disabled / setup_error / migration_error / setup_retry / removed rooms are excluded and count toward nothing (operator option a); loading rooms block outright; live rooms must be LOADED, coordinator-present and seen; failed exclusion is sticky until LOADED; a zone blocked only by a reloading room and empty holds its preset (safety force-away still writes).
why: Round 5 reverted the operator's live-rooms decision to all(zone.rooms) on the orchestrator's own adjudication instead of fixing round 4's any() bug. The opus-5 planner's formula let a reloading, previously-seen room satisfy establishment (the exact cold-retreat hazard); hand-check + opus-5.5 plan review caught it. Operator then moved planner/builder/reviewer to claude-opus-5-5 ('5 often built the wrong thing').
implications: Never overturn an operator decision by adjudication — fix the implementation. Hand-check any opus-5 output. Call-site wire-in anchors are mandatory (a tested helper is not a tested call site — the fix-up was sent back once for this).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a zone is observed retreating while any of its rooms is loading.
